svg.aria-label: Running a few AI agents at once? / Not anymore. Whatever needs you shows up first. / Your other agents report in on their own. / Wherever you use Claude Code. / Easy on the eyes, light or dark.
svg.title: Agent Board: Stop checking on your agents. Let them tell you.
